A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable, complete 20-page versions of the same SynFER study. Their text, equations, Tables 1–8, Figures 1–11, and Appendices A.1–A.5 can be matched despite relocations and revised plots.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation-quality measurements, user-study outcomes, FER experiments, ablations, and appendix sensitivity results.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical studies, including revised self-supervised learning results in Table 2 and Figure 7.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same FEText construction, two-stage diffusion fine-tuning, AU adapter, semantic guidance, and FERAnno label-calibration procedure. No algorithmic or architectural component changes.

E1.justification: The FEText source datasets and evaluation coverage are unchanged, including supervised and self-supervised FER, compound-expression few-shot recognition, and zero-shot evaluation. Removing individual baseline scores does not remove AffectNet from evaluation.

E2.justification: Table 2 removes MCF and PCL from the reported AffectNet comparison: their respective scores of 65.28 and 68.35 become dashes. Their RAF-DB and SFEW results remain, and the other comparator sets are unchanged.

E3.justification: The experimental prose and Appendix A.2 settings are unchanged. However, Figure 7(b,c) changes its y-axis wording from 'Top-1 Accuracy' to 'Linear Probe Performance' while retaining supervised-learning captions. The PDFs do not resolve whether this indicates a protocol revision or a labeling error.

E4.justification: Figure 7(a) revises the AffectNet SSL scaling curve and real-data reference, changing the evidence about performance versus synthetic dataset size. The component ablations, FERAnno attention analysis, appendix guidance-strength sensitivity study, and over-smoothing comparison are retained.

E5.justification: Uncertainty reporting is unchanged, including Table 4's reference to 95% confidence intervals. No repeated-run counts, seed information, uncertainty estimates, or statistical testing procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 2 substantially replaces all nine SimCLR, BYOL, and MoCo v3 AffectNet scores. For MoCo v3, real/synthetic/mixed-data scores change from 74.53/77.43/77.82 to 51.03/55.56/57.84; the synthetic-only advantage changes from 2.90 to 4.53 percentage points. MCF/PCL AffectNet entries are withdrawn, and Figures 1(c) and 7(a) reflect the revised SSL results. The PDFs do not explain these numerical replacements.

T1.justification: The diffusion definitions, training objective, and semantic-guidance mathematics in Equations 1–6 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same novelty, effectiveness, and scalability claims. The abstract's 67.23% and 69.84% headline results and the introduction's +2.90-point SSL claim remain unchanged despite revisions to supporting results.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning FAU control, semantic guidance, FERAnno localization, and distribution alignment remain unchanged. Appendix A.4 retains the same limitations concerning augmentation-only use, slow generation, and restriction to FER.

D1.justification: Appendix A.2 and Tables 7–8 retain the same optimizers, learning rates, batch sizes, epochs, augmentations, FAU combinations, and 50-step denoising schedule with guidance during the last five steps. Both versions promise future code release; no new access or implementation information appears.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and reference list are unchanged. The added Yuan et al. (2023) citation in Figure 7(c) repeats an already cited work and does not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: The main prose, section sequence, and appendix organization remain essentially verbatim. Textual edits are limited to the version/date header and a small Figure 7(c) caption refinement.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 7 are redrawn with revised typography, legends, scales, and axis wording. Existing Figures 4, 7, and 8 and Tables 1 and 7 move within the document. The figure/table inventory and most illustrations remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Reporting consistency declines. In v1, the introduction's +2.90-point SSL gain agrees with Table 2; in v2, that unchanged statement conflicts with the revised +4.53-point gain. Figure 7(b,c) also introduces 'Linear Probe Performance' labels despite retaining supervised-learning captions. These new inconsistencies modestly weaken clarity. The numerical replacements alone do not establish improved experimental validity.
